name: Peru
summary: Peru combines state reserve creation for peoples in isolation with Indigenous-led territorial governance over intact Amazon forest.
featured_achievements: Sierra del Divisor Occidental Reserve was officially established at 515,115 hectares.
Indigenous Nations strengthened control over nearly 4.7 million hectares.
Wampis Indigenous Guard secured official state recognition as a self-defence body.

stories.title: Protection for peoples in isolation
stories.summary: After years of advocacy by multiple partners, the reserve for peoples in isolation and initial contact was formalised.

stories.title: Madre de Dios funding power dynamics
stories.summary: Partners addressed governance tensions that can arise when large grants reshape local institutional dynamics.

quote.text: Achieving and maintaining secure tenure includes mapping, resolving conflicts, governance, and defending land from outside threats.
